name: agg_preference_00
persona: a 60-year-old retired bank manager in Kolkata, takes up new hobbies

Lately I've been preferring episodes that are around 45‑60 minutes for deeper dives; my earlier short‑episode habit has changed.
My grandson's birthday party was wonderful; we celebrated with cake and balloons.

I need something easy‑listening while I cook, so not overly technical and pleasant to have in the background.
I have to book a doctor appointment for next week.

I really dislike background ads in podcasts; they break the flow.
Spent a lovely afternoon at the park; the weather was perfect for a walk.

name: agg_preference_01
persona: a 36-year-old HR manager in Hyderabad planning a wedding season

messages.text: Work was crazy today, had back‑to‑back meetings and missed lunch.
I love paneer tikka, I like it spicy but not too hot.
I've started a low‑carb diet for the wedding prep, trying to avoid rice.
I used to love chicken biryani, but lately I'm avoiding it because of carbs.
The monsoon rain was heavy today, I had to work late.
My friend Anu loves extra spicy food, but I prefer mild.
I don't usually like desserts, but the mango kulfi from the new shop was okay.
Planning a vegetarian appetizer for the wedding, maybe stuffed capsicum with cheese.
I need gluten‑free options for my dad's allergy.
Looking for a caterer near Gachibowli, easy to deliver.
It was chilly this morning, I had tea.
I've started enjoying mild roasted pumpkin soup, it's become a favorite.
Trying to keep protein high, so I like lentil salads.
The wedding is on June 15, I need dishes that can be prepared in bulk.
Tried a low‑sugar carrot halwa, it turned out great.
My sister visited, we went shopping for sarees.
I used to avoid avocado, but now I love avocado toast for breakfast.
